messages:
marta: I scanned an archived CI log and found what looks like a DockerHub auth token leaked in plain text. not seeing successful pushes yet but need containment. posting snippet and job.

marta: ```\n[2026-03-19T02:14:07Z] INFO Running step: docker login\n[2026-03-19T02:14:08Z] INFO Auth token: dhp_abc1234xyz (redacted)\n```\njob: ci/partner-integration/build #4821

aj: ack. can you point to the artifact location? I’ll revoke any matching robot tokens immediately.

marta: artifact located in gs://redwood-ci-logs/artifacts/partner-integration/4821/log.txt. token string matches value in vault path `secret/data/ci/legacy/dockerhub` from when we migrated off Jenkins.

samir: is that Vault KV v1 or v2? we need to ensure we update the right path if we're writing KV v2.

marta: legacy path is KV v1 style; we should migrate to `secret/data/ci/dockerhub/partner-integration` (KV v2) and restrict access.

kev: rotation first: who has DockerHub org owner? aj?

aj: taking ownership. revoking suspected robot `ci-legacy-robot-01` now. creating a short-lived, scoped robot token `ci-temp-2026-03` but not publishing it anywhere. will report back in :3min:
aj: revoked `ci-legacy-robot-01` (disabled). created `ci-temp-2026-03` with pull-only scope. not stored yet.

marta: thanks. containment checklist proposal:
- revoke leaked token (done)\n- create new secret at `secret/data/ci/dockerhub/partner-integration` (KV v2) and write new token there\n- update CI to read via Vault agent instead of env var dump\n- purge or mark as containing secrets any archived logs/artifacts that contain the token\n- enable Vault audit logging on the `ci` namespace and restrict read ACLs to `ci-builders` group only\n- add automated rotation for tokens if DockerHub supports ephemeral tokens, else schedule weekly rotation

samir: add to that: enable detailed Vault read events to our splunk/audit ingestion and keep logs for at least 30 days. current policy only logs writes.

kev: opening infra ticket to enable KV v2 auditing and increase retention to 48h minimum for P1. assigning to eng-infra. ticket #INFRA-2026-314. tag: p1.

marta: i'll run a grep sweep across GCS and S3 for token-like patterns and assemble a list of affected artifacts. estimate 20-40 minutes.

deploy-bot: CI job ci/partner-integration/build #4821 flagged: secret_exposure=true, archive quarantined.

aj: DockerHub audit: i'll check pushes by `ci-legacy-robot-01` for the last 90 days and any image pushes outside our org. will also check rate-limits/failed push attempts.

marta: quick findings: found 6 archived logs containing the token string; none show a successful docker push command exit 0. still treating as compromised for rotation.

samir: action owners recap:\n- aj: DockerHub revoke + audit check + create scoped token (in progress)\n- marta: artifact sweep & redact/purge exposed logs\n- kev: infra ticket for Vault audit + RBAC cleanup (remove `jenkins-legacy`, `old-robot` bindings)\n- aj + samir: implement automated rotation job if API supports; fallback to weekly rotate and update Vault entries\n- security-oncall: file incident and classify severity, notify partner security if partner-owned secrets

security-oncall: creating incident IR-2026-0421. preliminary severity: medium (credential exposure with no confirmed push). will notify partner-eng if credential map indicates partner-owned token.

marta: CI change notes: switch docker login to use `vault-agent` template and avoid printing auth in logs. example snippet to populate token:
```
# write new token into KV v2 path
vault kv put secret/data/ci/dockerhub/partner-integration token=@/tmp/ci-token
# pipeline should read with vault-agent and pass via stdin to docker login
echo "$TOKEN" | docker login --username $DOCKERHUB_USER --password-stdin
```
avoid using `--password` on the command line or echoing env vars.

aj: i'll update pipeline and verify runner log redaction. also enabling `--log-level=error` for the docker step so token strings don't get emitted.

samir: also adding a CI lint gate to detect common token prefixes and fail the job if present before artifact archiving. small secret-scan pre-commit hook + job in CI.

kev: RBAC: set Vault policy so only `group:ci-builders` and our deploy service account can read `secret/data/ci/dockerhub/*`. remove legacy service accounts from that policy.

marta: please add timeline to the incident with all steps and owners. i'll upload artifact list and redaction actions when sweep completes.

aj: DockerHub audit returned no pushes outside org. no image was pushed with that token. still rotating weekly for at least 4 weeks.

deploy-bot: artifact quarantine completed: 6 files redacted, 0 images found.

marta: thanks all. next: postmortem scheduled tomorrow with infra, ci, security to review how legacy pipelines kept secrets in logs and plan permanent mitigation. adding notes to IR-2026-0421. :thumbsup:
